text:
ashley: Heads up — Dedicated canary (us-east-1) is showing a p95 jump to ~420ms on text-gen routes since the merge that rolled in latebind kernel selection (PR #4128). SLA alarm firing for one customer :grimacing:

bjorn: I saw the same in telemetry. KV cache miss rate jumped at the same time; looks like latebind is picking a kernel that disables our prefetch path for some sequence shapes. starting a quick bisect.

deploy-bot: Deployed canary caa3f -> PR #4128 by @bjorn at 2026-03-18T09:12:23Z.

mike: Can you paste the perf snapshot? curious if it's kernel exec time or more GC/alloc pressure.

bjorn: profile dump from the canary node attached below (trimmed):
```
hot function: select_kernel_latebind 38.1%
hot function: kv_cache_lookup 22.7%
hot function: callback_prefetch_if_needed 14.3%
kv miss rate: baseline 2.1% -> canary 17.9%
avg tokens/sec down ~27%
```

lucy: That kv miss rate is massive. My hypothesis: the new selector defers kernel choice until runtime-slice and omits the historical prefetch hint for long-short sequences, so the cache isn't primed.

oncall: Confirmed customer-facing alert: dedicated cluster dc-17 saw p95 step from 180ms -> 420ms for about 12m window. I paused traffic routing to canary pool and opened a hold on the Dedicated rollout.

ashley: Good call to pause. We need short-term mitigation (revert/hotfix) and a longer fix for latebind to preserve prefetch hints.

bjorn: Bisect points to commit 5f9d2e6 (latebind selector refactor). Reproduced locally with a microbenchmark for mixed-length workloads. Reproduction script below:
```bash
# repro script (simple):
python perf_repro.py --model gpt-like --seq-dist "short:0.7,long:0.3" --kernel latebind
# observe p95 increase and kv miss spike
```

mike: Two mitigation options:
- quick revert of 5f9d2e6 (fast, known-good)
- patch selector to copy old prefetch hint into latebind decision (smaller change, needs test)

lucy: I can prepare the selector patch. Patch would be: preserve prefetch window and force prefetch path on dedicated pools. Rough diff: add `if (pool.type==DEDICATED) keep_prefetch_hint=true`.

ci-bot: perf/e2e job perf/regression-us-east-1 failed on canary: p95 2.3x baseline, kv miss assertion triggered. Build 8791.

oncall: We should treat this as rollout blocker for Dedicated tier until resolved. Customer SLA risk confirmed.

ashley: Decision: hold rollout (already paused), revert not yet applied. bjorn + lucy to produce either a revert PR or a minimal hotfix by EOD. mike to notify SRE and AE for affected customer. I'll open PERF-4921 and note the rollback window.

bjorn: starting revert PR now, will also run the benchmark matrix. Linking PR when ready.

lucy: I'll prototype hotfix in a branch (latebind-prefetch-guard). If tests pass faster we can ship hotfix and avoid full revert.

mike: Notifying AE + support on status. tagging affected customer threads.

ashley: Thanks. Keep updates in this thread. If either fix lands, re-run perf/e2e and rerun canary with 10m ramp before resuming Dedicated rollout. :thumbsup:
